layout_summary: A minimalist two-column editorial parody poster on a pure white ground, pairing a bleeding red stiletto-trident and overflowing spread jar on the left with a stacked serif movie-title lockup on the right. A single centered red rounded-sans tagline anchors the bottom edge, surrounded by generous white space.

alignment_axes: DEVIL (x=46.5%) and BISCOFF (x=46.0%) share a near-aligned left edge around x=46.0%
DEVIL (right edge x=89.5%) and BISCOFF (right edge x=91.0%) share a near-aligned right edge around x=90.0%
Bottom tagline is horizontally centered on the canvas (x=7.0% to x=93.0%, center axis x=50.0%)
whitespace: 10.0% empty white band across the top above the stiletto tip
10.0% horizontal gutter between the right edge of the shoe/jar scene (x=36.0%) and the title lockup (x=46.0%)
37.0% open white space on the lower right between BISCOFF (y=55.5%) and the bottom tagline (y=92.5%)
10.0% vertical gap between the bottom of the spread drip (y=82.5%) and the bottom tagline (y=92.5%)

scene.subject: A glossy red patent-leather stiletto shoe cropped at the left edge, whose slender heel morphs into a three-pronged red trident dipping into an open glass jar of smooth golden-brown biscuit spread, with thick spread overflowing and dripping down the right side of the jar onto the white surface
scene.composition: Vertically stacked on the left third of the canvas; the shoe enters diagonally from the left edge (y=10% to y=52.5%) and connects directly into the jar sitting below (y=55.5% to y=82.5%)
scene.camera: Eye-level studio product shot, crisp focus throughout with deep depth of field
scene.lighting: Bright, clean studio lighting from the upper right creating sharp white specular highlights on the red shoe and jar rim, with a soft diffuse shadow cast to the bottom-left of the jar

elements.text: Don't be silly Andrea, everybody wants this.

ornaments.description: Black devil-tail arrowhead extending upward from the right diagonal stroke of the letter V in DEVIL

why_it_works: Instant cultural recognition: replicates the exact white-ground composition, red-and-black serif lockup, and trident-stiletto motif of The Devil Wears Prada poster.
High-contrast negative space keeps the eye locked onto the visual pun (trident dipping into the spread jar) before sweeping right to the headline.
Color restraint (pure white, crimson red, black, and caramel brown) unifies the brand jar with the movie-poster aesthetic.
